verdict.rationale: Docs confirm refunds can be created via the API endpoint and manually via the Mollie Web app (dashboard), and the idempotency docs explicitly reference 'partial refunds' as a supported operation, confirming both full and partial refund support across both surfaces. Missing for 10: no dedicated Refunds API reference doc explicitly listing full vs partial refund parameters, and no independent/hands-on confirmation beyond first-party docs.
